ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 16, no Compton-Getting correction, Survival Probability corrected, Ram-directional, Galactic ENA Maps, Level H3, eleven-year average Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and validated against SPASE 2.7.1, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 16 eleven-year combined Galactic hydrogen ENA maps from ram-direction observations, with no Compton-Getting correction and with survival-probability correction applied. The product spans the complete Release 16 eleven-year interval from 2008-12-25 through 2019-12-26 and contains 60 by 30 all-sky maps for IBEX-Hi energy channels 2-6. The channel 2-6 FWHM energy ranges are 0.52-0.95, 0.84-1.55, 1.36-2.50, 1.99-3.75, and 3.13-6.00 keV, with nominal energies 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV. The CDF includes mapped energy, differential flux, signal-to-noise ratio, flux variance, counts, exposure time, samples per pixel, and CDAWeb virtual alternate-view variables. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R16_NOCG_SP_RAM_GALA_11YR.

NumericalData.Caveats: The ProductKey identifies this as the Galactic eleven-year product, and the IBEX Release 16 documentation states that combined Galactic maps are provided for the astrophysical community. The current CDAWeb CDF skeleton nevertheless retains Solar Ecliptic FIELDNAM/CATDESC labels and the generic ParameterKey names Latitude, West_Longitude, and East_Longitude. The SPASE display names therefore follow the Galactic product identity while preserving the CDF ParameterKey values. SPASE 2.7.1 has no controlled CoordinateSystemName value for Galactic coordinates, so no CoordinateSystem element is assigned for this map frame.
